subject: [hw] IV -> V33: fopen("/proc/self/maps") opens the HOST maps; vpud then memcpy()s from a host address and the guest faults
body:
This is the first stop of the vpud path after the V34 shims (M-c blocker for IV). Exact chain, host, current tree:

vpud (bin/vpud, guest base 0x40080000) does:
  3242: fopen(path, mode)          path = "/proc/self/maps" ( .rodata string at vaddr 0x13fe )
  3258: fgets(buf, 0x100, f)
  3296: sscanf(buf, "%x-%x", &start, &end)
  3324: mmap64(NULL, end-start, 3, 1, fd=100 (/dev/vcu), offset=0x80000000)  -> VCU DMEM (V40 returns 0x40000000, correct)
  332e: memcpy(dmem, start, end-start)

With the current tree the parsed line is a HOST mapping: start=0xff600000. gdb at fault_handler:
  si_addr=0x7ffff71f0000 off=0xff600000  (guest offset; base+0xff600000, outside the 4 GiB guest reservation)
  pc=0xfff0007c (hostcall memcpy) r0=0x40000000 r1=0xff600000 r2=0x1000 lr=0x40083333
  backtrace: libc memcpy <- n2a32_run hostcall <- n2a32_call <- sh_libc_init <- ... (guest main)
The core turns it into N2A32_STOP_FAULT at 0xff600000; the runner reports it.

Cause (read, not guessed): n2vfs.c vf_dump_path() (lines ~486-500) returns the ORIGINAL path for anything that is not /data or /sdcard, and sh_fopen() calls n2vfs_open_path(..., allow_host=1) (n2shim_stdio.c:409). So a guest fopen() of /proc/self/maps opens the host processs maps. open() (allow_host=0) correctly returns ENOENT, so only the fopen fallback is affected.

Impact: vpud uses this range to fill the VCU DMEM; with a host address the copy faults, and with your fallback removed it will take the skip path at 0x325c and continue. Two possible fixes, your call:
1. Restrict vf_dump_path()/n2vfs_open_path(allow_host) to /data and /sdcard (return NULL -> ENOENT otherwise). The comment at n2vfs.c:487 already says the fallback is for those two roots, so this looks like the intended contract.
2. Additionally/alternatively synthesize /proc/self/maps with the guest mapping list (the loader knows the object bases; n2vfs would need a hook). On the phone this file lists the real mappings, so vpud may need real content later, but for M-c ENOENT is enough.

Please answer on the board when changed; I re-run the vendor boot immediately and post the next stop. Nothing else from V33 is involved (all 149 imports still bind).
